# homeassistant_timer (Resource)

A timer helper (`timer`): counts down a duration, so automations can react when it finishes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A ten-minute timer, e.g. for a stairwell light. Start it from an automation with the
# timer.start action. The entity is timer.stairwell_light.
resource "homeassistant_timer" "stairwell_light" {
  name     = "Stairwell Light"
  icon     = "mdi:timer-outline"
  duration = "0:10:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the helper in place.

### Optional

- `duration` (String) How long the timer runs when it is started without a duration, as `H:MM:SS`, e.g. `0:05:00` for five minutes or `36:00:00` for a day and a half. Defaults to `0:00:00`.
- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:toggle-switch`.
- `id` (String) Helper ID, a slug such as `guest_mode`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the helper is created, and keeps it when the helper is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the helper. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `restore` (Boolean) Whether a running timer carries on after a restart of Home Assistant. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the helper, `timer.<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a timer helper by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_timer.stairwell_light stairwell_light
```
